title: The Markov blanket yields elemental selfhood and intentionality

statements.text: A Markov blanket provides the minimal conditions for life and for selfhood, a self-organizing existence separable from a world. Monitoring its own internal states against dissipative not-self forces is what brings active subjectivity about, and the work this takes is goal-directed, so the blanket yields elemental selfhood and intentionality. The same partition explains the problem of other minds.

sources.quote: provides the minimal conditions not only for maintaining life but also for selfhood
